notes.title: Zombilliard, Zombiesucker, and other insane ways to kill zombies
notes.notes: [p]My indie game ZDSS: Zombie Drone Survival Show is all about smashing zombies with drones and wild mechanics like Zombilliard, Piercing, ZombieSucker, Lift to Heaven, BBQ, Electric Cooker, and more. Here’s the first trailer — would love to hear what you think![/p]

notes.title: **Out with the Old Brains, In with the New Shots!**
notes.notes:
I’ve ditched those crusty old screenshots (RIP, outdated pixels ) for fresh, bloody visuals straight from the latest *Zombie Drone Survival Show*.  

Now featuring:  
🧟‍♂️ New locations, more zombies, zero mercy  
💥 Drone carnage — now 100% more explodey  
🖥️ Cleaner UI, filthier gameplay  
🎯 More chaos, more lasers, no outdated vibes  

My Steam page finally matches the game’s current mayhem. Check out the new screenshots and imagine the stench of burning zombie flesh. (Optional, but encouraged.)  

💚 Don’t forget to Wishlist! Keep your drone fed and ready for carnage.  

Stay tuned — the undead are brewing something *nasty*.
